timeline.summary: The Viridian Elves arrest Glissa and Slobad for the murder of Glissa's parents.
timeline.quote: were immediately arrested by the Viridian Elves for the murder of Glissa's parents

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves who blame Glissa for vanishing kin.
timeline.quote: Glissa and Slobad were captured by Viridian elves

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves, learn Lyese is alive, and are tried by a tribunal that acquits Glissa; Lyese attacks and all three fall.
timeline.quote: The council quickly decides that Glissa is not guilty, but Lyese takes her acquittal poorly and attacks.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "After the Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch draws the Viridian elves to Mirrodin from another world.
timeline.quote: by Mirrodin's mad guardian, Memnarch

citation.text: "Elf", section "Viridian Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Survivors of the Vanishing organize as the Resurgents.
timeline.quote: Many of those who survived the Vanishing called themselves the Resurgents

citation.text: "Elf", section "Viridian Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Goblins laugh as an elf runs away, until more elves return.
timeline.quote: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

citation.text: Wirewood Herald (Duel Decks: Elves vs. Goblins, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor's eerie transformation is complete as gloom deepens; selkies, duergar and hobgoblins thrive and drive elves and kithkin back into their strongholds.
timeline.quote: the plane's eerie transformation is complete.

citation.text: "Eventide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As depicted in the art of Blunt the Assault, nim attack Viridian elves in the Tangle without harming the unconcerned elves above.
timeline.quote: They must be nim, the necrogen-plagued undead of the Mephidross.

citation.text: "The Key Is Time". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Under Ezuri the Viridian Resurgents embark on a mission to destroy the myr, vedalken and anything unnatural.
timeline.quote: Under the leadership of the charismatic Ezuri, they embark on a mission to destroy the myr, the vedalken, and anything else they deem unnatural.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Viridians reject the Tel-Jilad hierarchy and form voluntary brigades called gades.
timeline.quote: Once the Viridians rejected the hierarchy of the Tel-Jilad, they organized themselves into voluntary brigades.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ezuri leads many Viridian elves into hiding and builds a small resistance in the treetops.
timeline.quote: Under Ezuri's leadership, however, many of the Viridian elves were able to hide and escape the Phyrexian onslaught.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After the Fifth Dawn, the elves retreat into the trees in fear and begin to turn on each other.
timeline.quote: As a result, the elves retreated inward, taking refuge in natural niches inside the massive trees of the Tangle.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ezuri emerges as a leader, rallying the Viridians and giving them new purpose.
timeline.quote: A young elf named Ezuri began to unify the Viridians and direct them toward productive tasks.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ezuri organizes the elves into a resistance and contacts other survivors across Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Eventually, he organized them into a resistance movement and contacted other survivors across Mirrodin.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elves are driven to extinction on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: but were driven to extinction

citation.text: "Elf", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian invasion destroys the plane's power balance and nearly decimates the Lorwyn elves, whose networks of power are turned to Phyrexian use.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian invasion destroyed the fragile power balance of the plane

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Untainted Lorwyn elves ally with the other species and make a stand at Lys Alana.
timeline.quote: they were finally able to gain ground and make a stand at Lys Alana.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Elvish authority in Lorwyn collapses as the invasion destroys the infrastructure of the power imbalance, letting other species reclaim sovereignty.
timeline.quote: This vacuum allowed the other species on the plane to gain ground, clawing back ancestral lands and reclaiming sovereignty.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
timeline.quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling reveals the elf torches hold captive sunlight elementals.
timeline.quote: Chained and captive and carried into night.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The elves charge and join battle with the kithkin.
timeline.quote: Then, with a peal of silvered bells, they surged forward and joined the battle.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kithkin arrows knock reliquaries from elves, freeing the sunlight elementals and transforming the elves into their Shadowmoor selves.
timeline.quote: gasped and changed, flesh and bone melting smoothly into their Shadowmoor selves.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar hits an elf archer with a rock and defiantly tells the elves to back off.
timeline.quote: We just want to go home

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
timeline.quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Touched by an elf's sunlit reliquary, Oko turns into his Lorwyn self and transforms the elf into an elk.
timeline.quote: The elk that stood in his place looked bewildered

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The elementals' dance ends; Isilu heads back toward its cavern as the night recedes and transformed kithkin and elves return to their Lorwyn selves.
timeline.quote: As the ribbons of night unwound, the transformed kithkin returned to their original states.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Thallids gain sentience and the elves split over destroying or aiding them.
timeline.quote: The elves would be split into two factions

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
